initialization: Reuse all four saved d16_l2 parents. Identical zero Adam moments and exact-FS policy as registered raw/VAP controls. No fresh capacity or initialization search.
objective: Total E_H + lambda*<S2>; lambda in J1 units. Report E_H, Var(H)/N, S2 and exact singlet weight separately. Physical states remain fixed-Sz/A1, not exact SU2. No projector in training or deployed amplitude.
controls: Reuse sealed raw and VAP continuations with identical 256-attempt policy; do not retrain them. Postprojection is a read-only diagnostic, not a scalable energy result.
budget: Eight N16 continuations, <=40 active CPU minutes plus preparation/tests. No automatic lambda-grid extension. No new Hamiltonian ED or remote job.

ratio_preflight.policy: N16 use the eight highest parent Born-weight basis states for replay only. N36 use the first eight sealed checkpoint chains, freeze model, no new sampling or training. Compare packed opposite-pair S2 with independent all-pairs action and physical full-H timings; pointwise values are NOT expectation estimates.

decision: Report every lattice/seed/lambda against its raw control in physical energy, variance and S2. Compare gap to exact VAP. A lower penalized loss or higher purity alone is not a win; exact-support success and N36 kernel timing do not license N36 training or establish scalable exact SU2.
